answer: A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a fleet in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, because every identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The prism cap is checked at intake and willow reveals the per-origin counts. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a oasis tag. That is 28 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
